title: Missing docs/CONSTITUTION.md — patrols running without mandate
description: Article IX: the population is running without its mandate. docs/CONSTITUTION.md does not exist in the repository (verified 2026-10-12: no docs/ directory, no file anywhere outside .git). Multiple scheduled patrols explicitly cite it as their standard, including tastewatch's own trigger (tastewatch-sample in .warren/triggers.yaml: 'Sample merged work from the past 7 days against docs/CONSTITUTION.md'). Evidence: git show 2b55f12 confirms main HEAD; find -name CONSTITUTION.md returns nothing. Until the constitution is restored, taste audits are ungrounded and gatewatch/ratchetwatch have no ratchet to measure against. Action needed from the repo owner: commit the recorded taste document. Report-only agents cannot author the owner's taste; this seed is the tracking vehicle, not the fix.
